policy: Only source-attributed government issuer statements, distinct from independently authenticated before-and-after document changes and never evidence of wrongdoing. This publication does not assert camera locations, installation verification, signed payment, or effective policy beyond original issuer's dated statement.

leads.title: Panama City publicly reports a vote to terminate and remove a subset of Flock cameras
leads.published_finding: The municipal announcement states that on September 8, 2026, commissioners voted unanimously to terminate and remove 41 Flock cameras on state rights-of-way and requested options for remaining cameras.
leads.reviewed_original_evidence: City of Panama City 'Commission Takes Action on FLOCK Cameras' municipal notice, updated September 8, 2026.
leads.verified_boundary: This verifies the text of a city-issued decision announcement, not that the equipment was later physically removed, that the vendor contract ended, or that all city cameras were disabled.
what_is_unknown: What original signed contract clause and notice governs termination?
What completion notice proves the affected equipment was actually removed?
What council action was taken for the remaining cameras?
leads.further_verification: Review September 8 commission minutes and signed termination notice, obtain completed FDOT removal inventory.

leads.agency: Michigan Department of Technology Management and Budget
leads.title: Michigan procurement directory lists Flock license-plate reader contract 250000000832
leads.published_finding: Michigan's official procurement directory lists Flock Group Inc. doing business as Flock Safety, contract 250000000832, for a hosted license plate reader solution, with a displayed contract expiration date of June 3, 2030.
leads.reviewed_original_evidence: Michigan Department of Technology, Management and Budget official MiDEAL systems/data reporting contract index, original Flock contract listing.
leads.verified_boundary: A statewide procurement listing is not proof that any particular Michigan city bought, deployed or paid for Flock equipment; renewal terms and amendments require the executed file.
what_is_unknown: Which participating agencies issued purchase orders under the contract?
Where are the executed agreement, extensions, invoices and effective terms?
Does the listed expiry reflect amendments not visible in this directory?
leads.further_verification: Retrieve contract 250000000832 and amendments, government purchase-order and invoice records by participating agency.

leads.title: Hillsborough's municipal notice reports ending a Flock contract and later camera removal
leads.published_finding: The town's October 28, 2025 announcement describes ending its Flock camera contract; an update dated December 3 reports that all Flock cameras contracted by the town had been removed.
leads.reviewed_original_evidence: Town of Hillsborough official news release dated October 28, 2025 and updated December 3, 2025.
leads.verified_boundary: Town-published removal is an attributed official statement rather than an independent physical camera audit; no conclusion is drawn about other agencies' devices.
what_is_unknown: Where are the formal executed termination agreement and final vendor invoices?
Did the town receive written vendor deletion or preservation confirmations?
Which public contract terms governed removal and data retention?
leads.further_verification: Obtain town contract, termination correspondence, final closeout records and public release of vendor data-deletion policy.
